status: Partial: adopted Python/history, sparse-residency, real-detector and browser scale anchors received; thirty active cycles in one kernel remain pending

resource_profile.monitoring: Shared available RAM, memory-pressure and swap activity; descendant ownership/cleanup. Supervisor overhead is separate from child cgroup limits.

measurements.scope: E2 Python atom/structure and history anchors; three fresh workers per anchor, not cold filesystem caches or browser/device receiving

scope_limits: Constructed molecular supercells and rigid-drift structures, not an observed MD trajectory.
Three fresh Python workers per anchor; filesystem/JIT caches are not claimed cold.
Worker RSS includes native fixture assembly and Python dependencies; it is not Viewer-only memory, browser RSS or hardware VRAM.
History captures 25 production state checkpoints, then verifies empty history after clear; peak RSS and allocator retention do not independently prove a leak.
Historical August baseline uses Python 3.13 and different software/resources. No comparable-condition regression/pass threshold is inferred from direct cross-date ratios.
Source measurements only; no clean installed package, other OS, human acceptance or publication is claimed.

Synthetic rings are peptide atom groups used to measure sparse participant/centroid costs, not detected aromatic chemistry. H5MSM interaction-layer reads materialize the selected analysis and are warm-process measurements.

Browser firstVisible now means an actual Mol* didDraw with matching model atom count and three exact float32 source-coordinate probes, not simply renderable bounding geometry or two animation frames. It is not an every-pixel proof.

Rendering uses actual ANGLE/Vulkan SwiftShader. Browser process-tree RSS sums shared pages and is not cgroup physical consumption or hardware VRAM. Missing /proc samples remain unavailable, never zero; reactivation needs a successful qualified process sample. Hardware VRAM requires a qualified hardware-GPU profile.

Benchmark-only provenance/invariant/statistic instrumentation follows the production source base. Exact measured source hashes are retained; this is not a new full platform or installed qualification.

identity.scope: Source exercise, not an installed package or cross-platform qualification. Resource limits describe this child scope; supervisor overhead is separate.
